study type: Cross-sectional study (using data from five Demographic and Health Surveys)
exposure: sector of childbirth care provision (public vs. private)
outcome: proportion of births attended by skilled professionals
receipt of four components of immediate postpartum care
cohort: Women who gave birth in Egypt between 1995 and 2014
finding: While Egypt saw a large increase in facility births and births attended by skilled professionals, the quality of immediate postpartum care remained subpar, highlighting the need for improvements in both public and private sectors.
